_about: Curated reference meanings for common Indian road signs, written in general educational language and based on the categories of IRC:67-2022 (Code of Practice for Road Signs). Used to ground the LLM. Review with your team and extend as needed.

signs.name: Stop
signs.shape_colour: Red octagon with white STOP text
signs.meaning: Vehicles must come to a complete stop before the stop line and proceed only when the way is clear.
signs.purpose: Controls right of way at junctions where a full stop is needed for safety.

signs.name: Give Way
signs.shape_colour: Inverted triangle with red border
signs.meaning: Drivers must give priority to traffic on the main road and proceed only when it is safe.
signs.purpose: Manages priority where a minor road joins a major road.

signs.name: No Entry
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a white horizontal bar
signs.meaning: Vehicles are not allowed to enter the road from this direction.
signs.purpose: Prevents wrong-way traffic, usually at the exit end of one-way roads.

signs.name: One Way
signs.shape_colour: Rectangular sign with an arrow
signs.meaning: Traffic on this road moves in one direction only, shown by the arrow.
signs.purpose: Organises traffic flow on narrow or busy roads.

signs.name: Vehicles Prohibited in Both Directions
signs.shape_colour: Plain red circle on white background
signs.meaning: No vehicles are allowed on this road in either direction.
signs.purpose: Closes a road to vehicles, for example a pedestrian-only area.

signs.name: Speed Limit
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a number (km/h) in the centre
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not exceed the speed shown in km/h on this stretch of road.
signs.purpose: Keeps speeds safe for the road conditions, area and nearby users.

signs.name: No Parking
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with red border and one red diagonal line
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not be parked at this location.
signs.purpose: Keeps the road clear for moving traffic and access.

signs.name: No Stopping or Standing
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with red border and a red cross
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not stop or stand at this location, even briefly.
signs.purpose: Prevents obstruction on busy roads and junctions.

signs.name: Overtaking Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle showing two cars side by side
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not overtake other vehicles on this stretch.
signs.purpose: Prevents dangerous overtaking where visibility or road width is limited.

signs.name: U-Turn Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a U-turn arrow and a red diagonal line
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not make a U-turn here.
signs.purpose: Avoids conflicts with oncoming traffic.

signs.name: Left Turn Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a left arrow and a red diagonal line
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not turn left at this point.
signs.purpose: Controls turning movements at junctions.

signs.name: Right Turn Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a right arrow and a red diagonal line
signs.meaning: Vehicles must not turn right at this point.
signs.purpose: Controls turning movements at junctions.

signs.name: Horn Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a horn symbol and a red diagonal line
signs.meaning: Use of the horn is not allowed in this area.
signs.purpose: Reduces noise near hospitals, schools and silence zones.

signs.name: Pedestrians Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a walking person and a red diagonal line
signs.meaning: Pedestrians are not allowed on this road.
signs.purpose: Protects pedestrians on roads such as expressways.

signs.name: Cycle Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a bicycle symbol
signs.meaning: Bicycles are not allowed on this road.
signs.purpose: Keeps slow cycles away from high-speed traffic.

signs.name: Truck Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a truck symbol
signs.meaning: Trucks and goods vehicles are not allowed on this road.
signs.purpose: Protects narrow or residential roads from heavy vehicles.

signs.name: Bullock Cart Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a bullock cart symbol
signs.meaning: Bullock carts are not allowed on this road.
signs.purpose: Separates slow animal-drawn carts from fast traffic.

signs.name: Hand Cart Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a hand cart symbol
signs.meaning: Hand carts are not allowed on this road.
signs.purpose: Keeps slow hand carts off busy roads.

signs.name: Tonga Prohibited
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a horse-drawn cart symbol
signs.meaning: Horse-drawn carts (tongas) are not allowed on this road.
signs.purpose: Separates animal-drawn vehicles from fast traffic.

signs.name: Width Limit
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with arrows and a width value
signs.meaning: Vehicles wider than the value shown are not allowed.
signs.purpose: Protects narrow roads, gates and bridges.

signs.name: Height Limit
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with arrows and a height value
signs.meaning: Vehicles taller than the value shown are not allowed.
signs.purpose: Prevents tall vehicles hitting bridges, underpasses or wires.

signs.name: Load Limit
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with a weight value in tonnes
signs.meaning: Vehicles heavier than the weight shown are not allowed.
signs.purpose: Protects weak bridges and roads from damage.

signs.name: Axle Load Limit
signs.shape_colour: Red circle with an axle symbol and a weight value
signs.meaning: Vehicles whose load per axle exceeds the value shown are not allowed.
signs.purpose: Protects road surfaces and bridges.

signs.name: Restriction Ends
signs.shape_colour: White circle with black diagonal lines
signs.meaning: The restriction shown earlier (such as a speed limit or no-overtaking zone) ends here.
signs.purpose: Tells road users that an earlier restriction no longer applies.

signs.name: Compulsory Ahead Only
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with a white upward arrow
signs.meaning: Vehicles must go straight ahead only.
signs.purpose: Controls traffic direction at junctions.

signs.name: Compulsory Turn Left
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with a white left arrow
signs.meaning: Vehicles must turn left.
signs.purpose: Directs traffic at junctions and one-way systems.

signs.name: Compulsory Turn Right
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with a white right arrow
signs.meaning: Vehicles must turn right.
signs.purpose: Directs traffic at junctions and one-way systems.

signs.name: Compulsory Keep Left
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with a white arrow pointing down-left
signs.meaning: Vehicles must keep to the left of the sign or obstruction.
signs.purpose: Guides traffic around traffic islands and dividers.

signs.name: Compulsory Ahead or Turn Left
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with arrows ahead and left
signs.meaning: Vehicles must either go straight or turn left.
signs.purpose: Restricts turning options at a junction.

signs.name: Compulsory Ahead or Turn Right
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with arrows ahead and right
signs.meaning: Vehicles must either go straight or turn right.
signs.purpose: Restricts turning options at a junction.

signs.name: Compulsory Cycle Track
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with a white bicycle
signs.meaning: This track is for cyclists, who must use it.
signs.purpose: Separates cyclists from motor traffic.

signs.name: Compulsory Sound Horn
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with a white horn symbol
signs.meaning: Drivers are required to sound the horn here.
signs.purpose: Warns hidden oncoming traffic, for example on blind hill bends.

signs.name: Pass Either Side
signs.shape_colour: Blue circle with two downward arrows
signs.meaning: Vehicles may pass on either side of the sign or island.
signs.purpose: Guides traffic around a central obstruction.

signs.name: Left Hand Curve
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a curve to the left
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead bends to the left.
signs.purpose: Gives road users time to prepare for the bend.

signs.name: Right Hand Curve
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a curve to the right
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead bends to the right.
signs.purpose: Gives road users time to prepare for the bend.

signs.name: Left Hair Pin Bend
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a sharp U-shaped bend to the left
signs.meaning: Warns of a very sharp, U-shaped bend to the left ahead.
signs.purpose: Common in hill roads; warns of a dangerous bend.

signs.name: Right Hair Pin Bend
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a sharp U-shaped bend to the right
signs.meaning: Warns of a very sharp, U-shaped bend to the right ahead.
signs.purpose: Common in hill roads; warns of a dangerous bend.

signs.name: Left Reverse Bend
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with an S-shaped bend starting left
signs.meaning: Warns of a bend to the left followed by a bend to the right.
signs.purpose: Warns of a double bend ahead.

signs.name: Right Reverse Bend
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with an S-shaped bend starting right
signs.meaning: Warns of a bend to the right followed by a bend to the left.
signs.purpose: Warns of a double bend ahead.

signs.name: Steep Ascent
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle showing an upward slope
signs.meaning: Warns of a steep uphill section ahead.
signs.purpose: Helps road users prepare for a steep climb.

signs.name: Steep Descent
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle showing a downward slope
signs.meaning: Warns of a steep downhill section ahead.
signs.purpose: Helps road users prepare for a steep descent.

signs.name: Narrow Road Ahead
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with two lines coming closer
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead becomes narrower.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to reduced road width.

signs.name: Road Widens Ahead
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with two lines moving apart
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead becomes wider.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a change in road width.

signs.name: Narrow Bridge
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a narrowing bridge symbol
signs.meaning: Warns of a bridge ahead that is narrower than the road.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to limited width on the bridge.

signs.name: Slippery Road
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a skidding car
signs.meaning: Warns that the road surface ahead may be slippery.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a higher risk of skidding.

signs.name: Loose Gravel
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle showing scattered stones
signs.meaning: Warns of loose gravel or stones on the road ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to reduced grip and flying stones.

signs.name: Falling Rocks
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with falling rocks
signs.meaning: Warns that rocks may fall onto the road in this area.
signs.purpose: Common in hilly areas; alerts road users to the hazard.

signs.name: Cycle Crossing
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a bicycle
signs.meaning: Warns that cyclists may cross the road ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to watch for cyclists.

signs.name: Pedestrian Crossing
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a person walking on a crossing
signs.meaning: Warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to watch for people crossing.

signs.name: School Ahead
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with children walking
signs.meaning: Warns of a school ahead where children may be on or near the road.
signs.purpose: Protects children near schools.

signs.name: Men at Work
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a person working
signs.meaning: Warns of road work or workers on the road ahead.
signs.purpose: Protects road workers and alerts road users to changes.

signs.name: Cattle
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a cow
signs.meaning: Warns that cattle may be on or crossing the road ahead.
signs.purpose: Common in rural areas; alerts road users to animals.

signs.name: Cross Road
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a cross symbol
signs.meaning: Warns of a junction ahead where two roads cross.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to traffic from side roads.

signs.name: T-Intersection
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a T symbol
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead ends at a T-shaped junction.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users that they will need to turn.

signs.name: Y-Intersection
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a Y symbol
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead splits into two.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a fork in the road.

signs.name: Side Road Left
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a side road joining from the left
signs.meaning: Warns that a side road joins from the left ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to traffic joining from the left.

signs.name: Side Road Right
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a side road joining from the right
signs.meaning: Warns that a side road joins from the right ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to traffic joining from the right.

signs.name: Staggered Intersection
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with offset side roads
signs.meaning: Warns of side roads joining from both sides at slightly different points.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to traffic joining from both sides.

signs.name: Major Road Ahead
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a thick horizontal road
signs.meaning: Warns that the road ahead meets a major road.
signs.purpose: Prepares road users to give way to main-road traffic.

signs.name: Roundabout
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with circular arrows
signs.meaning: Warns of a roundabout ahead.
signs.purpose: Prepares road users for circular traffic movement.

signs.name: Speed Breaker
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle showing a bump
signs.meaning: Warns of a speed breaker or hump on the road ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a raised section designed to reduce speed.

signs.name: Dangerous Dip
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle showing a dip in the road
signs.meaning: Warns of a sudden dip in the road surface ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a change in road level.

signs.name: Gap in Median
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle showing a break in the divider
signs.meaning: Warns of an opening in the road divider ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to vehicles crossing or turning through the gap.

signs.name: Barrier Ahead
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a barrier symbol
signs.meaning: Warns of a barrier, such as a check post, on the road ahead.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a point where they may need to stop.

signs.name: Guarded Level Crossing
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a gate symbol
signs.meaning: Warns of a railway level crossing ahead that has gates or barriers.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a railway crossing.

signs.name: Unguarded Level Crossing
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a train symbol
signs.meaning: Warns of a railway level crossing ahead without gates or barriers.
signs.purpose: Alerts road users to a crossing where extra care is needed.

signs.name: Ferry
signs.shape_colour: Red-bordered triangle with a boat
signs.meaning: Warns that the road leads to a ferry crossing.
signs.purpose: Prepares road users for a water crossing point.

signs.name: Hospital
signs.shape_colour: Blue rectangle with a red cross or H symbol
signs.meaning: Shows that a hospital is nearby.
signs.purpose: Helps road users find medical help.

signs.name: First Aid Post
signs.shape_colour: Blue rectangle with a first-aid cross
signs.meaning: Shows that a first-aid post is nearby.
signs.purpose: Helps road users find basic medical help.

signs.name: Petrol Pump
signs.shape_colour: Blue rectangle with a fuel pump symbol
signs.meaning: Shows that a fuel station is nearby.
signs.purpose: Helps road users find fuel.

signs.name: Parking
signs.shape_colour: Blue rectangle with a white P
signs.meaning: Shows a place where parking is allowed.
signs.purpose: Helps road users find authorised parking.

signs.name: Eating Place
signs.shape_colour: Blue rectangle with a cutlery symbol
signs.meaning: Shows that a place to eat is nearby.
signs.purpose: Helps road users find food facilities.

signs.name: Light Refreshment
signs.shape_colour: Blue rectangle with a cup symbol
signs.meaning: Shows that light refreshments are available nearby.
signs.purpose: Helps road users find a place to rest and refresh.
